name: DayChunksPub
description: Minimalist time-blocking tool for Deep Work. Visual timeline, audio alarms, works 100% offline. No login, no tracking, no cloud. Built with Blazor WASM. Private by design. Slice your day into meaningful chunks! 🚀

paragraphs: DayChunks is a privacy-focused, standalone web application designed for high-focus "Deep Work." It allows you to slice your day into meaningful, color-coded time chunks using an interactive visual timeline.
In an era of cloud-first tools that harvest user data, DayChunks offers a "tools-for-thought" approach:
features: No Login Required: Start planning in 2 seconds. No accounts, no onboarding, no friction.
Privacy by Design: All data is stored locally in your browser's storage. Your schedule never leaves your device.
Offline-Ready: Built as a Progressive Web App (PWA) – it works perfectly without an internet connection.
Visual Timeline: A "buttery-smooth" interactive axis for a bird's-eye view of your daily flow.
Audio Cues: Stay in the zone with customizable audio alarms for each time-chunk.
